title: La Patrona del Cafetal, MEXI STORIES
comment: cafetal-coatepec (MEXI): patio de secado de una hacienda cafetalera en Coatepec, Veracruz. Caras comunes, no famosas; los tres se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.GRISELDA_MONTIEL: Mexican woman, cold and feared owner of a coffee hacienda, 45 years old, fair skin, straight jet-black hair in a severe high ponytail, sharp cheekbones, dark red lipstick, a fitted black long-sleeve riding jacket over a white blouse, beige riding trousers, tall brown leather boots, small silver earrings, her hands empty.
chars.CELESTINO_BARRAGAN: Mexican man, new foreman looking for work, 40 years old, tanned brown skin, short dark hair, a short dark beard, calm deep-set eyes, a worn brown leather jacket over a grey henley shirt, jeans, work boots, a palm-leaf hat in his hand, his hands otherwise empty.
chars.FELIPA_CRUZ: Mexican woman from Veracruz, housekeeper of the hacienda, 61 years old, brown skin, grey curly hair tied back with a white ribbon, kind round face, a plain pale-yellow long-sleeve blouse, a long dark-brown skirt, a white cotton shawl, sandals, her hands empty.

locs.LOC_CAFETALCOATEPEC: Large stone drying patio of an old coffee hacienda in Coatepec, Veracruz, in the misty morning: red coffee cherries and pale beans spread to dry on the stones, white colonial arches of the hacienda house with red tile roofs, green coffee plants and banana trees on the hills beyond, soft fog, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
